thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 09/07/2018: OKTA, MRVL, PANW, VEON, AVGO, CI - Nasdaq.com

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 09/07/2018: OKTA, MRVL, PANW, VEON, AVGO, CI - Nasdaq.com
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Technology Stocks:
MSFT: -0.5%
AAPL: -0.3%
IBM: flat
CSCO: flat
GOOGL: flat
Technology shares were mixed to lower in pre-market trading on Friday.
Expected movers:
- Okta ( OKTA ) posted Q2 results that topped expectations and guided for Q3 and FY18 above Street view
- Marvell Technology Group ( MRVL ) said Q2 earnings and revenue missed forecasts and guided Q3 below Street view
- Palo Alto Networks' ( PANW ) fiscal Q4 results exceeded Street estimates
Other news:
- Veon ( VEON ) completed the sale of its 50% interest in Wind Tre to CK Hutchison for gross proceeds of EUR2.45 billion
- Broadcom ( AVGO ) reported double-digit growth in revenue as enterprise storage demand surged
- Cigna Corp.'s (CI) wholly owned unit, Halfmoon Parent, priced $20 billion of senior notes
